notes.title: ASIC + BTC mining Update 1.0.4!
notes.content:
Hi! We just released new update 1.0.4!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268200/26b13d15ee6680036f7a84b57655a81aff12e380.png[/img]

Change Log:
- Added different ASICs miners!
- Added SHA-256 Algorithm + BTC Mining!
- Added new Item in shop - Rack for ASICs!
- Added electricity bills (charges automatically every 30 days)
- Fixed trading bugs!
- Small fixes!

Have fun!

New updates are coming!

In future updates:
- Warehouse inventory!
- Coming custom items: gaming chairs, tables, PCs, monitors, stereo, consoles, couches, beds, etc!
- New coins mining coming!

notes.title: GTX 1060, 1070, RTX3090 Update 1.0.3 + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello gamers! We just published new update 1.0.3!

Change Log:
- Added GTX 1060 6GB, GTX 1070 8GB, RTX 3090 24GB!
- Added new customer orders!
- Added volume settings!
- Added mouse sensitivity!
- GPU wear reduced!

- Fixed saving freezes!
- Fixed game crashes!

notes.title: Overclock Update!
notes.content:
Hello! Just released new update 1.0.2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268200/77cbc9832843574a33378ab6f150903d760763ee.jpg[/img]

Changle Log:
- Added overclocking GPU (Core Clock, Mem Clock, Fan Duty)
- Added GPU wear depending on temperature and overclock!
- GPU failures due to overheat or high wear!
- Added rig terminal with few commands (will be added with new updates)
- Added 2500W PSU!
- Added different SSD: 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024 MB!

Bug fixes:
- Fixed saves bugs with balance and deleting profiles.
- Fixed rigs saving with disappearing GPUs, etc.
- Small fixes.
